Multiverse Computing has introduced the LittleLamb model family, a new line of compact AI models designed for edge, on‑device, and agentic use cases. The launch expands the company’s focus on lightweight, high‑performance systems that can operate efficiently in constrained environments. The announcement highlights LittleLamb’s role in enabling more autonomous and responsive AI applications across diverse deployment scenarios.
